description: List the covered cities and metro areas with the number of venues in each, grouped by country. Use it when the user asks where CourtlyGo has data, for “which city has the most courts” questions (detail=true gives venue counts by sport; say these are counts of mapped venues, not a quality ranking), or after search_courts says a city is unknown; you do not need it before searching. It does not list courts: to find courts, call search_courts with city=<a name from this list>. Pass 'country' (e.g. 'Spain') to list one country; 'detail'=true adds per-city counts by sport (large).

country.description: Only this country, name or ISO code, e.g. 'Spain' or 'ES'.

detail.description: Per-city counts by sport and hidden-private counts (much larger answer).

name: list_coverage
title: List coverage
